user: I avoid using any beauty products that are not cruelty-free and vegan.
assistant:  It's great that you're mindful about using cruelty-free and vegan beauty products. By choosing not to use products that have been tested on animals or contain animal-derived ingredients, you're taking a stand against animal cruelty and supporting companies that align with your values.

To ensure that the beauty products you use are cruelty-free and vegan, look for certifications from organizations such as Leaping Bunny, PETA, or the Vegan Society. These certifications indicate that the products have been produced without harming animals.

Additionally, you can check the ingredient lists of the products you're considering to make sure they don't contain any animal-derived ingredients. Some common animal-derived ingredients to look out for include beeswax, lanolin, carmine, and collagen.

By being a conscious consumer and choosing cruelty-free and vegan beauty products, you're helping to create a more ethical and compassionate world. Keep up the good work!
